A synthetic network/vpn lookup row references the intended Network Support group; the rule contains no fixed group identifier."}],"considerations":"Use the same application scope as the utility. Coordinate field-message ownership so one script does not clear another script's advice. Prefer UI Policies for declarative field behavior, and validate important rules on the server too."},{"id":"glideajax","category":"GlideAjax","title":"Retrieve Server Data from a Client Script","purpose":"Fetch a synthetic support hint asynchronously and apply it to the form.","context":"Browser ↔ Server / Synthetic guidance lookup","workflow":["Client Script","GlideAjax","Script Include","Server Response","Form Update"],"blocks":[{"title":"Client Script · category onChange","language":"javascript","code":"function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {\n    if (isLoading) return;\n    g_form.hideFieldMsg('category', true);\n    if (!newValue) return;\n\n    var requestedCategory = newValue;\n    var ajax = new GlideAjax('PortfolioSupportAjax');\n    ajax.addParam('sysparm_name', 'getHint');\n    ajax.addParam('sysparm_category', requestedCategory);\n    ajax.getXMLAnswer(function(answer) {\n        // Ignore a response for an outdated selection.\n        if (g_form.getValue('category') !== requestedCategory) return;\n        if (!answer) return;\n        g_form.hideFieldMsg('category', true);\n        g_form.showFieldMsg('category', answer, 'info');\n    });\n}"},{"title":"Script Include · client callable","language":"javascript","code":"var PortfolioSupportAjax = Class.create();\nPortfolioSupportAjax.prototype = Object.extendsObject(\n    global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {\n        getHint: function() {\n            var category = this.getParameter('sysparm_category');\n            // Allowlisted synthetic data;
